title: Chiropractic Office
description: Inquiries, patients, visits and prepaid packages for a chiropractic office.

spec.useCase: Bao Trinh works the front desk at a two-chiropractor office and uses this to return new inquiries the same day, run today's visits and see which prepaid packages are nearly used up or about to expire.

text.text: Your chiropractic office on one page. Start with Inquiries to call back today, then Visits for the day's schedule, and keep an eye on Packages so nobody loses prepaid visits. Operational tracking only; clinical notes stay in your clinical system.
A call back inside one business day is the biggest factor in whether someone books.
Say your name and the practice name, then thank them for reaching out.
Ask what is going on and how long; write it on the inquiry.
Offer two first-visit times and book one.
Send the intake form by email or text.
Mark the inquiry Booked and add the person under Patients.
If no answer, leave a message and try again the next day.
Press Sell a package on the patient.
Enter visits included, price and expiry date.
Explain that each completed visit uses one.
Visits left updates itself as visits are marked completed.
Packages with two visits left or expiring in 30 days show on the Dashboard.
Mark them Expired and let the provider know before the next visit.
Initial exam booked with enough time
Welcome and tour of the office
Care plan discussed and next visits booked
Patient status moved to In care
Call back every inquiry marked New
Mark all visits completed or missed
Check packages with two visits left
